title: Normalization with 50ml tubes
author: Opentrons
materials: Create your CSV file according to our instructions.

Make sure to add reagents to your labware before placing it on the deck! Your diluent should be in a 50ml tube in the A3 spot (upper left) of your tube rack, and the samples you’re normalizing should be in your plate.

steps.title: Create and format CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file (.csv) in landscape orientation where each cell contains the volume (in μL) to add to the corresponding well; the first cell corresponds to well A1 (upper‑left). Include volumes for all wells of your 96‑ or 384‑well plate (e.g., 40 μL for A1, 41 μL for B1, etc.). Use the provided template if desired.

steps.title: Upload CSV and set parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons Normalization app, upload the prepared CSV file and select the desired settings (plate type, tip size, etc.) to customize the protocol run.

steps.title: Download customized OT‑2 protocol
steps.instruction: Click the blue “Download” button above the deck map to download the generated Python protocol for the OT‑2 robot.

steps.title: Add diluent and samples to labware
steps.instruction: Place a 50 mL tube containing the diluent in position A3 (upper left) of the 4‑in‑1 tube rack; load your 96‑ or 384‑well plate with the samples to be normalized onto the deck.

steps.title: Upload protocol to Opentrons App and run
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons App, then follow the on‑screen instructions to set up the deck layout, calibrate the labware, and start the run.
